title: Conditioning Out the Poor? Consumption Inequality and the Design of Cash Transfer Programs
title_zh: 排除穷人？消费不平等与现金转移计划的设计
authors: Anagol, Santosh, Fujiwara, Thomas, Navarrete, Martin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Conditionality can exclude poor households from receiving transfers. Reanalyzing five randomized evaluations of conditional cash transfers (CCTs), we find that 9–37 percent of eligible recipients fail to meet conditions, and they typically have lower baseline consumption. We assess the welfare implications of budget-neutral shifts from CCTs to unconditional cash transfers. Conditionality exacerbating inequality among eligible recipients can be quantitatively important for welfare impacts. We quantify how large conditionality-induced human capital gains must be for the welfare benefits of CCTs to outweigh the inequality costs generated by conditionality.
abstract_zh: 条件性可能导致贫困家庭无法获得转移支付。通过对五项有条件现金转移支付（CCTs）的随机评估进行再分析，我们发现9%至37%的合格受助者未能满足条件，且这些家庭通常基线消费水平较低。我们评估了从有条件现金转移支付转向无条件现金转移支付的预算中性调整对福利的影响。条件性加剧合格受助者之间的不平等，可能对福利效应产生显著的量化影响。我们量化了条件性带来的人力资本增益需达到何种程度，才能使有条件现金转移支付的福利收益超过条件性所产生的不平等成本。

title: Platform-Mediated Competition
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In many markets the interaction between individuals and competing firms is mediated by a strategic platform. A defining feature of modern platforms is their extensive ability to control interactions. To understand such markets, I incorporate within-side externalities into a general mechanism-design model of many-to-many matching in two-sided markets. I characterize platform-optimal mechanisms and establish comparative statics. I analyze the implications and welfare effects of changes in market structure, including vertical integration by the platform and changes in the platform's information about firms. I then extend the canonical Dixit-Stiglitz model of monopolistic competition by giving the platform control over consideration sets.
abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，个体与竞争企业之间的互动由战略性平台中介。现代平台的一个显著特征是其对互动的广泛控制能力。为理解此类市场，我将同侧外部性纳入双边市场中多对多匹配的一般机制设计模型。我刻画了平台最优机制并建立了比较静态分析，进而探讨市场结构变化（包括平台纵向整合及平台对企业信息的变化）的影响与福利效应。最后，我通过赋予平台对考虑集合的控制权，扩展了经典的迪克西特-斯蒂格利茨垄断竞争模型。

title: Screening Adaptive Cartels
authors: Ortner, Juan, Chassang, Sylvain, Kawai, Kei
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We propose an equilibrium theory of data-driven antitrust oversight in which regu- lators launch investigations on the basis of suspicious bidding patterns and cartels can adapt to the statistical screens used by regulators. Our main result establishes that screening for collusion using tests with a low false-positive rate (safe tests) is a robust improvement over laissez-faire. Safe tests do not create new collusive equilibria, and do not hurt competitive industries. In addition, safe tests can have strict bite, including unraveling all collusive equilibria in some settings.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种数据驱动反垄断监管的均衡理论，其中监管机构基于可疑投标模式发起调查，而卡特尔组织能够适应监管机构使用的统计筛查手段。我们的主要结论表明，采用低误报率（安全检验）的合谋筛查方法，相较于自由放任政策具有稳健的改进效果。安全检验既不会催生新的合谋均衡，也不会损害竞争性行业。此外，安全检验具有严格约束力，在某些情境下甚至能瓦解所有合谋均衡。

title: Food Price Trends and Projections in Brazil (2018–2026): Implications for Access to Adequate and Healthy Food
title_zh: 巴西食品价格趋势与预测（2018-2026年）：对获取充足健康食品的影响
authors: Thaís Cristina Marquezine Caldeira, Bruna Barbosa Furtado, Ana Maria Thomaz Maya Martins, Laís Amaral Mais, Ramon Torres, Rafael Moreira Claro
abstract: This study analyzed post‐COVID‐19 trends in food prices in Brazil and projected changes through 2026. Time series from the 2017/2018 Household Budget Survey, the National System of Consumer Price Indexes, and the Continuous National Household Sample Survey were analyzed using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models. Between 2018 and 2024, prices of ultra‐processed food products (UPFP) decreased by 16%, while unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients increased, narrowing the price gap. The nominal prices of food groups rose more than nominal household income between 2018 and 2024, particularly for unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients. Projections indicate that UPFP will remain the cheapest group by 2026, reinforcing barriers to healthy diets and supporting tax policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究分析了巴西在新冠疫情后的食品价格趋势，并预测了截至2026年的变化。研究利用2017/2018年家庭预算调查、国家消费者价格指数体系以及连续全国住户抽样调查的时间序列数据，采用季节性自回归积分滑动平均模型（SARIMA）进行分析。2018年至2024年间，超加工食品（UPFP）价格下降了16%，而未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料的价格则有所上涨，从而缩小了价格差距。2018年至2024年间，各类食品的名义价格涨幅超过了名义家庭收入，尤其是未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料。预测显示，到2026年，超加工食品仍将是最便宜的类别，这加剧了健康饮食的障碍，并为税收政策提供了支持依据。

title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
title_zh: 税收激励与风险资本风险承担：来自QSBS项目的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Do tax subsidies prompt investors to take on risk? We address this question by looking at investors' responses to changes to the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which reduces capital gains taxes on startup investing. We do so under a framework in which some startup investors — venture capitalists (VCs) — combine outside funding with incentive-based compensation, while others invest their own funds. Using bunching, triple-differences, and matching designs that exploit industry eligibility, investment vintage, and holding-period requirements, we analyze data from 158 thousand investor–firm pairings over two decades. We identify strategic investment timing, with subsidies prompting bunching at tax-eligible holding-period thresholds. Most notably, when and where tax subsidies apply, VCs shift their project selection toward riskier ventures: they invest more in pre-commercial stage startups, become more likely to provide startups with their initial capital, and invest more in startups with pre-existing debt, while becoming less likely to co-syndicate their investments. Tax-subsidized VC-backed ventures show higher failure rates, but on the flip side, attain higher valuations at exit and are more likely to reach "unicorn status." None of these patterns are observed for comparable non-VC investors in startups exposed to the same tax subsidies. Our tests further show that tax incentives lead to reallocation toward more innovative industries, yielding more impactful patents. Our study is the first to show that tax policy can shift entrepreneurial financing toward riskier, more innovative, and valuable startups.
abstract_zh: 税收补贴是否会促使投资者承担风险？我们通过考察投资者对合格小型企业股票（QSBS）计划变化的反应来探讨这一问题，该计划降低了初创企业投资的资本利得税。我们在一个框架下进行分析，其中部分初创企业投资者——风险投资家（VC）——将外部资金与基于激励的薪酬相结合，而其他投资者则使用自有资金。利用行业资格、投资年份和持有期要求，我们采用聚束分析、三重差分和匹配设计，对二十年间15.8万个投资者-企业配对数据进行分析。我们识别出策略性投资时机，即补贴促使投资者在符合税收优惠的持有期阈值处出现聚束现象。最值得注意的是，在税收补贴适用时，风险投资家将项目选择转向风险更高的企业：他们更多投资于商业化前阶段的初创企业，更可能为初创企业提供初始资本，并更多投资于已有债务的初创企业，同时减少联合投资。获得税收补贴的风险投资支持企业失败率更高，但另一方面，它们在退出时获得更高估值，且更可能达到"独角兽地位"。在面临相同税收补贴的可比非风险投资投资者中，未观察到这些模式。我们的进一步检验表明，税收激励导致资源向更具创新性的行业重新配置，产生更具影响力的专利。本研究首次证明，税收政策可将创业融资转向风险更高、更具创新性和价值的初创企业。

title: The Competitive Effects of Mergers with Cournot Competition
title_zh: 古诺竞争下并购的竞争效应
abstract: This article provides a full characterization of the competitive effects of horizontal mergers in the Cournot model with heterogeneous firms and constant marginal costs. We show that price effects depend only on the smaller merging firm's market share and the number of firms but are independent of the distribution of market shares among other firms. Standard concentration measures, instead, are often misleading. We also provide simple—yet general—closed‐form solutions for merger effects based on pre‐merger parameters. Moreover, we extend the model to study the combination of output and input market power and relate our results to the Merger Guidelines.
abstract_zh: 本文全面刻画了异质性企业且边际成本恒定条件下古诺模型中横向合并的竞争效应。研究表明，价格效应仅取决于规模较小合并企业的市场份额及企业数量，而与其他企业的市场份额分布无关。相比之下，标准集中度指标往往具有误导性。我们基于合并前参数，为合并效应提供了简洁而通用的闭式解。此外，我们将模型拓展至产出市场与投入市场势力的联合分析，并将研究结论与《合并指南》相关联。

title: The COVID-19 Pandemic and International Supply Chains
title_zh: 新冠疫情与国际供应链
authors: Kleifgen, Eva, Roth, Duncan, Stepanok, Ignat
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused major disruptions in international trade and has raised concerns about adverse effects on international supply chains. Using a unique establishment survey matched with administrative data from Germany, we provide novel evidence on how establishments have adjusted their supply chains in response to pandemic-induced disruptions. We find that establishments that experienced difficulties in obtaining intermediate inputs as a result of the pandemic are significantly more likely to change their network of suppliers than establishments without such problems, especially if disruptions affected imports from abroad. Establishments experiencing supply chain difficulties are more likely to replace a distant with a closer supplier. However, these adjustments in response to the pandemic appear to be temporary.
abstract_zh: COVID-19疫情对国际贸易造成了重大冲击，并引发了对国际供应链负面影响的担忧。通过将德国独特的机构调查数据与行政数据相匹配，我们提供了关于机构如何应对疫情引发的供应链中断而进行调整的新证据。研究发现，因疫情而面临中间投入品获取困难的机构，其调整供应商网络的可能性显著高于未遭遇此类问题的机构，尤其是当供应链中断影响到海外进口时。遭遇供应链困难的机构更倾向于用距离更近的供应商替代距离较远的供应商。然而，这些针对疫情的调整似乎是暂时性的。

title: Converging Paths : Intergenerational Educational Mobility and the Decline of Gender and Geographic Gaps in Bangladesh
title_zh: 汇聚之路：孟加拉国代际教育流动性与性别及地理差距的缩小
authors: Olivieri, Sergio, Razzu, Giovanni, Wambile, Ayago Esmubancha
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines intergenerational educational mobility in Bangladesh across cohorts born between the 1950s and 1990s, using data from the 2022 Bangladesh Household Income and Expenditure Survey. Intergenerational regression coefficients and intergenerational correlations are estimated, yielding three main findings. First, while the intergenerational regression coefficient declines for the 1990s cohort, suggesting reduced persistence of the effect of parental education on children's outcomes, the intergenerational correlation, which accounts for inequality in educational attainment across both generations, follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, resulting in no net mobility change. This finding reverses earlier evidence of increasing persistence through the 1970s and indicates that educational expansion since the 1980s has progressively benefited children of less-educated parents. Second, unlike patterns observed elsewhere in the region, where urban residence confers mobility advantages, Bangladesh exhibits no urban premium. Overall mobility remains higher in rural areas, although substantial convergence occurs in the 1990s cohort. At the regional level, an East-West convergence is observed, driven by mobility improvements in traditionally less-mobile Eastern regions. Third, women historically exhibited higher mobility than men through the 1980s, with gender convergence emerging only in the 1990s cohort, largely due to accelerated male mobility gains among urban males. Ba ngladesh's educational mobility trajectory is thus characterized by convergence across gender, urban-rural, and region dimensions, a pattern distinct from both its historical experience and broader South Asian trends, although educational gains remain disconnected from labor market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2022年孟加拉国家庭收入与支出调查数据，考察了20世纪50年代至90年代出生队列的代际教育流动性。通过估计代际回归系数与代际相关系数，得出三项主要发现。第一，尽管1990年代出生队列的代际回归系数有所下降，表明父母教育对子女教育影响的持续性减弱，但考虑两代教育成就不平等的代际相关系数却呈现倒U型模式，导致净流动性未发生改变。这一发现推翻了此前关于20世纪70年代教育持续性增强的结论，并表明自20世纪80年代以来的教育扩张逐步惠及低教育背景家庭的子女。第二，与南亚其他地区城市居民享有流动性优势的模式不同，孟加拉国并未呈现城市溢价。农村地区的整体流动性仍更高，尽管1990年代出生队列中城乡差距显著趋同。在区域层面，传统流动性较低的东部地区流动性改善，推动了东西部趋同。第三，历史上至20世纪80年代，女性流动性始终高于男性，但性别趋同仅在1990年代出生队列中出现，这主要源于城市男性流动性加速提升。因此，孟加拉国的教育流动性轨迹呈现性别、城乡与区域维度的全面趋同特征——这一模式既不同于其历史经验，也区别于更广泛的南亚趋势，尽管教育收益仍与劳动力市场表现脱节。

title: Socially Optimal Crime and Punishment
title_zh: 社会最优的犯罪与惩罚
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: This paper develops a dynamic equilibrium model of crime with heterogeneous agents and human capital accumulation. Agents decide whether to commit crimes by comparing potential gains with the expected punishment. Public security policies are defined as pairs of a size of the police force and an average sentence length. We propose a micro-founded public security technology linking expenditures on police to the probability of apprehension of a criminal. We illustrate the relevance of this theoretical framework by using an estimated version of the model using US data to (i) characterize the socially optimal public security policy; (ii) explore potential complementarities across public security and educational policies; and (iii) show that comparative statics exercises often lead, under reasonable parameter values, to recommendations that differ from those obtained in a global optimality analysis. These results highlight the relevance of equilibrium considerations in the economic analysis of crime. The paper gives a methodological first step towards building a manageable model of crime that can bring together different pieces of evidence—and equilibrium considerations—when evaluating the trade-offs across policy alternatives.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含异质性主体与人力资本积累的动态均衡犯罪模型。行为人通过比较潜在收益与预期惩罚来决定是否实施犯罪。公共安全政策被定义为警力规模与平均刑期长度的组合。我们提出了一种基于微观基础的公共安全技术，将警务支出与罪犯被捕概率相关联。通过使用美国数据对模型进行参数估计，我们阐明了该理论框架的适用性，具体用于：（i）刻画社会最优公共安全政策；（ii）探索公共安全政策与教育政策之间的潜在互补性；（iii）证明在合理参数取值下，比较静态分析得出的政策建议往往与全局最优性分析结果存在差异。这些结论凸显了均衡考量在犯罪经济学分析中的重要性。本文为构建一个可操作的犯罪模型提供了方法论基础，该模型能够在评估不同政策方案的权衡时，整合多元实证证据与均衡分析视角。
